kill_criteria: trailing 90-day value of the hourly taker under $10k a year at the quoted size (it was $238,869)
any confirmation paying less than its WithdrawalQueued hypeAmount, or a non-zero unstakeFeeRate
the fastest confirmation over a month above 10 days
withdrawals paused for over a week
under half of the qualifying sales still clearing the hurdle at the next hour's median over a quarter
legs: at each hour boundary, buy the previous hour's kHYPE sales whose edge cleared the hurdle back on the kHYPE/WHYPE pools (Project X, Ramses v3, Nest, HyperSwap v3, Hybra) at the market, priced at that hour's venue median
confirmWithdrawal after 7 days; unwrap or reuse the HYPE
mechanism: Anyone can queueWithdrawal(kHYPE) on Kinetiq's StakingManager; the HYPE amount is fixed at the request at StakingAccountant.kHYPEToHYPE and confirmWithdrawal pays it after withdrawalDelay (604,800 s); every one of 13,426 confirmations paid exactly its request and the 10bp unstake fee was set to zero on 2026-04-08. The taker prices against kHYPEToHYPE, waits the fastest confirmation seen within a day of the purchase (never under 7 days), charges two pool fees and the staking yield forgone while queued, and pays the venue median of the hour after the sale.
name: Buy kHYPE below the HYPE Kinetiq pays for it and redeem through the 7-day queue (hourly taker)

quotes.note: hourly taker at the next hour's venue median, 2025-07-15..2026-10-09 split 2026-02-26; hurdle h=20 chosen in sample (in sample $365,167), t 1.21; first-trade reading $121,174; late entry (later price) 1h 161%, 1d 113%; replaces the own-print quote of $140,043 only if the coordinator accepts it; the go rule (t above 2) fails at this size

risks: HYPE price exposure of the capital unless hedged (a short HYPE perp, which itself earns funding)
Kinetiq contract, validator slashing and governance risk on HYPE queued for a week
other bidders (Valantis STEX, arbitrageurs) not simulated: values are ceilings for one participant
lumpy: most of the value comes from stress episodes; the chosen hurdle (h=20) ranked 7 of 7 out of sample
thesis: kHYPE trades below the HYPE its withdrawal queue pays, and the discount lasts: 98% of the sales that cleared 1bp in their own hour still cleared it at the next hour's venue median (98% of those clearing 10bp still cleared 10bp), and the next hour always had trades. Bought back at each hour boundary at that hour's venue median, a $10,000,000 bid that redeems every fill made $113,872 a year out of sample (t 1.21, 95% interval $3,735 to $315,571), against $140,043 when each sale was bought at its own print; $121,174 at the first trade after the boundary; $334,407 at $30M (t 2.50).
